name: Gourmet India
notes: All 4 photos are legible menu boards, but every one is branded 'Urban India Restaurant & Bar', not 'Gourmet India' - flagging for review in case Google filed these under the wrong listing (or the restaurant was renamed). Photo 3 (clear laminated menu) was used as primary source for Burgers/Pizza/Burrito, Traditional Entrees, Rice, Naan, and Desserts; photo 1 (sidewalk sign) supplied Appetizers and Soup & Salad; photo 2 is a blurry duplicate of photo 3's entree/rice/naan/dessert section (superseded, not double-counted, minor price differences between the two treated as an update). Photo 4 is the same restaurant's weekday Lunch menu (Mon-Fri 11-3pm); its Appetizers/Salad&Soup/Main Entree Plates duplicate dishes already captured, so only its Tandoori Plates section (not clearly legible elsewhere) was added. Per-protein price variants (Chicken/Lamb/Shrimp/Paneer) are folded into one dish with all prices listed in the description rather than a single numeric price.
